title: 1994 Welch's Series 6 Tweety & Sylvester Jelly Jar - Vintage
descriptionText: This vintage Welch's Series 6 Edition Tweety and Sylvester Jelly Jar is a must-have for collectors of jam, jelly, and peanut butter memorabilia. The colorful multi-design on the jar makes it a great addition to any kitchen or advertising collection. This original piece was manufactured in the United States and features the beloved characters Tweety and Sylvester. Perfect for fans of the classic cartoon or anyone who appreciates unique and collectible advertising items.
